_note: TEMPLATE written by the author. A blind run needs a copy of this file with parameters chosen by the hand that runs it; the run refuses this file itself. Keys starting with an underscore are comments. All values are integers in parts per million, except from_t and latency_steps (steps). Allowed ranges: p_side_ppm inside [100000, 950000]; confidence_ppm inside [0, 1000000]; true_edge_ppm and signal_bias_ppm inside [-300000, 300000]; noise up to 300000; fee up to 200000; slippage up to 200000; latency up to 50 steps; from_t strictly increasing, first 0, below 6000. A regime may carry its own p_side_ppm. price = p_side - true edge; signal = p_side + bias + noise.
